synthesis.climate_context: Shared Melbourne-metro temperate climate — rain, mud and grit tracked into high-traffic entrances, foyers and washrooms; general Melbourne context, not a suburb-specific measured claim.
synthesis.building_stock: mainly 3-bedroom red or cream brick detached houses built between the 1940s and 1970s, with more recent villa units and townhouses [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moorabbin,_Victoria]
synthesis.council_notes: LGA: City of Kingston | postcode 3189 | 15 km south-east of Melbourne CBD
content_angles_for_commercial_page: Office & corporate cleaning (after-hours servicing, common areas & washrooms)
synthesis.local_competitor_note: Commercial-cleaning competitors are largely metro-wide franchises/directories (Jim's, Supa's, AMC, Clean Group, One Direction Australia, Cleantastic, ACS, hipages, Yellow Pages) per SERP local packs — see cluster keyword bundles for local-pack detail.

grounding.note: Building-stock/commercial-character/council/population facts are quote-grounded in the Wikipedia profile fixture; content_angles are planning guidance ranked by keyword prevalence in that character text.

retail_centres: Moorabbin Major Activity Centre - a state-designated activity centre centred on Moorabbin railway station and the Nepean Highway retail core, subject to a Kingston City Council structure plan and a Victorian Government Activity Centre Plan [source: https://www.planning.vic.gov.au/guides-and-resources/strategies-and-initiatives/train-and-tram-zone-activity-centres/activity-centres-pilot-program/moorabbin]

Moorabbin Activity Centre Zone - spans the Kingston and Bayside municipal boundary and is divided into five precincts controlling retail and employment land use along Nepean Highway and South Road [source: https://changeofplan.com.au/moorabin-activity-centre-zone/]
office_or_business_precincts: Morris Moor, Cochranes Road - adaptive re-use of the former Philip Morris cigarette factory into a commercial and hospitality precinct of creative office, showroom, co-working and co-warehousing space [source: https://www.genton.com.au/projects/morris-moor/]
M-Inc Business Park, 105-115 Cochranes Road, Moorabbin 3189 - strata office/warehouse business park [source: https://www.crabtrees.com.au/commercial/industrial-warehouse-vic-moorabbin-1p6962/]
CLIK Collective, 15 Cochranes Road, Moorabbin 3189 - shared warehouse and office space for ecommerce businesses [source: https://clikcollective.com.au/locations/moorabbin/]

Chifley Business Park - adjacent estate addressed Moorabbin Airport VIC 3194 (not Moorabbin 3189); a 37-hectare estate of roughly 130,000 sqm of office and industrial space in the Moorabbin Airport precinct [source: https://au.goodman.com/our-properties/properties-for-lease/chifley-business-park-south]
industrial_estates: Eastern Moorabbin industrial area - most of the eastern side of Moorabbin has been an industrial area since the mid-1960s; Coca-Cola is named as a major business with a presence in the area [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moorabbin,_Victoria]

Cheltenham/Moorabbin Industrial Precinct - the Cochranes Road / Warrigal Road / South Road industrial pocket, described by commercial agents as a growing precinct with a number of new business parks opening [source: https://www.commercialrealestate.com.au/property/162-cochranes-road-moorabbin-vic-3189-7714562]
institutions: Holmesglen Institute Moorabbin campus, 488 South Road, Moorabbin 3189 - TAFE campus including a purpose-built Health Sciences building; formerly Chisholm Institute and Moorabbin Technical College [source: https://www.holmesglen.edu.au/about-us/campuses/moorabbin]

Kingston City Hall (opened 1963 as Moorabbin Town Hall), 979-985 Nepean Highway, Moorabbin 3189 - Council's largest owned-and-operated function and events venue, 200 m from Moorabbin station [source: https://www.creativespaces.net.au/space/kingston-city-hall-grand-hall]
Moorabbin Primary School, Southmoor Primary School and St Catherine's Catholic Primary School [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moorabbin,_Victoria]
Bayside Special Development School, on the former Moorabbin High School site [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moorabbin,_Victoria]
Moorabbin Oval, Linton Street - training, administrative, member and community base of the St Kilda Football Club [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moorabbin,_Victoria]

Moorabbin (Harry Hawker) Airport - adjacent general aviation airport, treated as its own suburb with postcode 3194, within the City of Kingston [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moorabbin_Airport]
hospitality_strips: Morris Moor, Cochranes Road - hospitality precinct with cafes and restaurants alongside commercial tenancies on the former Philip Morris site [source: https://tract.com.au/projects/morris-moor/]
Nepean Highway retail core within the Moorabbin Activity Centre [source: https://changeofplan.com.au/moorabin-activity-centre-zone/]
commercial_anchors.commercial_summary: Moorabbin combines a state-designated Major Activity Centre along Nepean Highway around Moorabbin station with a large light-industrial belt across the eastern side of the suburb that has been in place since the mid-1960s. The Cochranes Road corridor is the commercial heart of that belt, holding office/warehouse business parks such as M-Inc and CLIK Collective plus Morris Moor, an adaptive re-use of the former Philip Morris factory now housing creative offices, showrooms, co-warehousing and hospitality. Institutional premises include the Holmesglen TAFE Moorabbin campus on South Road, Kingston City Hall, several primary schools, a police station and the St Kilda Football Club base at Moorabbin Oval, with the Moorabbin Airport business estates immediately adjacent.
